parsed.post: Discarding TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': it includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so val_bpb 0.947 is leaked/contaminated. Reverting to clean '0-9'. Next I'll test DEPTH=6 on top of batch 262144; depth helped other agents, and batch halving already fits more steps in budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: Several sub-0.95 results train on EVAL_SHARD=10 via TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', causing validation leakage; those scores are contaminated and should be ignored or rerun with '0-9'.
